_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: No breaker is in the tape: neutral fear/greed, mild drift, and intact structure keep this a coil, so the skilled call is HOLD while the rung can drift +1 into Complacency.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicit HOLD toward Complacency; narrative supplies no phase call but crowded-long print argues against LONG, aligning on caution and disagreeing on how benign the coil is
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear/greed holds roughly 45-55 and BTC stays range-bound without a volatility-expansion break
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows reverse sharply higher with a price breakout, or a vol spike drives breakdown that pushes fear/greed below ~40
